Natural Amethyst Geode Cluster Deep Purple Crystals Medium 10-15 cm
This natural amethyst geode cluster features deep purple crystals on one side and a rough, unpolished rock matrix on the other. The crystals show good clarity with a rich violet color and vary in size, displaying a layered structure transitioning from purple to clear and white at the edges. The specimen measures approximately 10-15 cm in length. It is in used but well-preserved condition with no visible damage or repairs. There are no manufacturer marks or branding, as this is a naturally occurring mineral specimen suitable for collectors, crystal enthusiasts, or as a decorative piece.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 12 Insulator
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Antique/Vintage
Authentic Hemingray No. 12 glass insulator, a classic piece of American industrial history. Produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, this model was widely used for telephone and telegraph lines during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. It features the signature aqua blue glass and technical design elements common to the era's utility infrastructure.
Embossed "HEMINGRAY NO. 12" on the front skirt
Embossed "PATENT MAY 2 1893" on the reverse side
Sharp drip points along the bottom base edge designed to shed moisture
Translucent aqua blue glass with characteristic manufacturing seed bubbles and swirls
Approximately 3.75 inches tall by 3 inches wide
Condition:
Significant chip and glass loss on the bottom skirt edge as shown in photographs. Minor surface soot and mineral deposits within the interior threads and grooves. Main dome and upper wire grooves remain structurally sound. Original glass color is vibrant with no internal stress cracks.

All items are donated and may exhibit signs of wear, including surface dirt, discoloration, scratches, and scuffs. Glassware and dishes may display color fading, crazing, or chips. Clothing items may have loose threads or fabric pilling. The full functionality of electrical items is not guaranteed. Purses may show wear on the bottom edges, corners, and handles. Jewelry metal content and stones have not been tested unless explicitly stated, and stones have not been individually inspected. Items sold in lots have not been counted or sorted and may contain small or damaged pieces. Returns are not accepted for these items.

description:
Van Meer
Sea Captain Smoking a Pipe
Oil on Canvas
21" x 25.5" (Frame Size)
Signed lower right
This classic maritime portrait features an elderly sea captain with a voluminous white beard smoking a pipe, rendered in a traditional realist style. Signed by the artist "Van Meer," this work is characteristic of mid-20th-century nautical genre paintings. The composition uses a dark, atmospheric background to emphasize the weathered features and contemplative expression of the subject, capturing the rugged character of a seasoned mariner.
Fine brushwork detailing in the textured beard and expressive facial features
Housed in a traditional dark wood frame with a cream linen-wrapped inner liner
Canvas is professionally stretched and secured with metal clips to the frame reverse
Frame dimensions: 21" Wide x 25.5" High x 1" Deep
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The oil paint surface remains vibrant and stable with no evidence of flaking or cracking. The canvas is tight and well-supported. The wood frame shows minor surface abrasions and light age-appropriate toning to the linen mat, but remains structurally sound with original hanging wire attached.

description: Educational Rocks and Minerals kit by Tangerine Press, Scholastic Inc., 2013. Suitable for ages 7 and up. Includes a 32-page book explaining rock formation and details on various rocks and minerals. Contains nine real mineral specimens: Tiger Eye, Unakite, Red Jasper, Rhodonite, Lemon Jade, Crystal Quartz, Dalmatian Jasper, Amazonite, and Amethyst. Each mineral is displayed in a clear plastic case. Outer packaging and book show used condition with visible wear but no major damage. Mineral samples appear intact. Ideal for young collectors and educational use. 9x6
